name: What is the typical cost range to build a detached ADU in Los Angeles County?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range to build a detached ADU in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a detached ADU in Los Angeles County can vary significantly based on factors like size, design complexity, finishes, and site preparation. Generally, homeowners can expect costs to range from approximately $150,000 to $350,000 or more. This estimate typically includes architectural plans, permits, construction, and basic finishes. High-end materials or challenging site conditions will increase the overall investment. It's advisable to get a detailed quote based on your specific project scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a detached ADU in Los Angeles County typically range from $150,000 to $350,000, depending on size, design, and finishes.
